title: expTerm(1) = 1 exactly, as a literal CReal equality
statement: Eq CReal (expTerm 1) CReal.one -- the CReal.expTerm_zero_eq_one analogue at n=1 (1/1! = 1/1 = 1), reused for CReal.sinOne_le_exp_term_one's own expTerm(1) where a caller needs the literal identification.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.expTerm_one_eq_one : Eq.{1} CReal (CReal.expTerm (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) CReal.one

evidence.supports: CReal.expTerm_one_eq_one is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
